acceptance_criteria: Name, description, coordinates, province/city, images, policies, and operating hours are provided; the campsite is created in Draft status; only an authenticated Host can create it.
Only the Host who owns the campsite can edit it; change history is saved; updated data is visible to Campers.
Each zone has a name, capacity, location, base price, amenities, and status.

The Host can select Campsite or Zone scope, start date, end date, and reason; the start date cannot be after the end date; Trips and trip_camp_stays overlapping the closure cannot be published or used.
Zone status uses the zone_status enum: active, closed, archived; zones with a status other than active cannot be selected for new overnight stays; affected Trips must be warned for handling.
The Host can add, delete, and reorder images; each image has a URL, type, and order; only the Host who owns the campsite can update them.

Only campsites with status = pending_approval can be reviewed; approval changes status to active. If not approved, status returns to draft for Host edits and the reason is saved in audit_logs/notifications; do not use rejected because the database does not define that status.
Filtering supports province/city, amenities, zone base price range, and status; only campsites with status = active are shown; results include name, location, cover image, and active routes.
Show images, description, location, amenities, policies, zones, upcoming Trips with status = published, weather, and reviews; do not show slots because the system manages campsites by zone.
The Host can draw a route or import GPX/GeoJSON; length, difficulty, estimated duration, and status are saved.
Each checkpoint has coordinates, radius, type, estimated time, and instructions.

story_title: Close or Open Route when Conditions Change
acceptance_criteria: Routes with status = closed do not accept new registrations or new Trips; related Campers and Porters receive notifications.

Routes with status = draft or pending_approval are checked for geometry, difficulty, and checkpoints; approval changes status to active. If not approved, status returns to draft for Host edits; if the route cannot operate, status becomes closed. Reasons are saved in audit_logs/notifications; do not use rejected.
Points are displayed on the map, included in the offline package, and include safety descriptions.
Show length, elevation, difficulty, duration, checkpoints, danger zones, water or shelter points, and route status; Weather Risk is shown when an assessment exists.

story_title: Fetch Weather Data for Trekking Area
acceptance_criteria: Rain, wind, temperature, visibility, thunderstorm data, and timestamp are stored; API timeout or missing data is handled.

story_title: Calculate Weather Risk Score by Multiple Criteria
acceptance_criteria: Risk score is calculated from rules and weights; the result is classified as Green, Yellow, or Red and must be reproducible.
Show which criteria exceeded thresholds; do not show only a color or total score.

story_title: Block New Registration when Route is Red
acceptance_criteria: Do not create new bookings for a Trip/route with Red risk; show the reason and assessment time; do not create Trip Member records because the system uses bookings and booking_members.

story_title: Use LLM to Explain Weather Risk as Clear Advice
acceptance_criteria: The LLM only explains the input data; it must not modify the risk score; the response includes concrete actions.
Weights, thresholds, version, and is_active status are saved; only one suitable version is used at a time; changes are audit logged.
